title: AnalyticsClaudeTagMetrics

active_day_count.title: Active Day Count
active_day_count.description: 1 on a day the user was active in Claude Tag in Slack, otherwise 0. Summed over the window in date-range mode, so it is the number of active days; on grouped rows, the total of each member's active days. Null when Claude Tag data cannot be read for the request. Otherwise, 0 on a row filtered by project, and null on any other row when no covered day was measured.

active_message_count.title: Active Message Count
active_message_count.description: Number of the user's Slack messages that made them active: @-mentions, direct messages, group direct message asks, and thread posts Claude answered. Other messages are not counted. Null when Claude Tag data cannot be read for the request. Otherwise, 0 on a row filtered by project, and null on any other row when no covered day was measured.

description: Claude Tag activity metrics for a single linked user on a given day.
